evidence: Matches 'Build system' label, modifies contrib/guix and ci/lint files to update Guix time-machine and fix native riscv64 builds.
rationale: Fixes native riscv64-linux host failures when running Guix builds. As documented in issue #36232, Guix builds fail natively on riscv64 because python-lief lacked riscv64 support in the older pin; while important for riscv64 builder support, it is not a tier-1 supported release architecture.
